"'''Dr. Gray'''" was the codename for a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working in [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] lab on a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] hybrid. Dr. Gray made several logs in a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] chip that was found by [[Jaden Korr]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the Sith&ndash;Jedi [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] turned mad and killed everyone in the lab. Jaden hypothesized she tried to reason with the clones, but was decapitated near a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] in which the clones placed her head. Dr. Gray's recording was a vital warning to Jaden Korr about the clones.
